scope: Public homepage, Status and Fit Studio
reference: Existing InFlite design tokens, translucent chrome, concentric shapes and restrained iOS-inspired spring motion

findings.issue: Problem report overlay could sit below an existing modal and keyboard focus could leave it
findings.change: Native modal top layer, keyboard wrapping, Escape and opener restoration

findings.issue: Settings close/back targets were40px and reduced transparency omitted header chrome
findings.change: 44px hit areas with existing visual geometry; solid header/report surfaces when requested

findings.issue: Long sheet titles overlapped scrolled content; Mail had small compose controls and missing field focus
findings.change: Painted bounded title chrome, stronger compose focus,44px recipient/account controls, reader wrapping

findings.issue: No quick return from history; long flight-card names and some sheet text overflowed; feedback varied
findings.change: Latest messages control, bounded names, larger mic target and shared press/release/reduced-motion feedback

findings.issue: Place controls squeezed names; delayed responses could show stale search results; reorder moved keyboard focus
findings.change: Responsive place editing, wrapped names, immediate query invalidation and preserved reorder focus

findings.issue: Steppers/week controls too small; numeric metrics clipped; availability drag lag and cancellation gaps
findings.change: 44px targets, full metric wrapping, vertical semantics/Home/End and safe direct drag response

findings.issue: Cash writes lacked visible progress/locking; long list entrance delays accumulated; hosted reduced-motion incomplete
findings.change: Saving/Removing states, stable submitted fields, explicit Close, bounded entrance delays and hosted motion parity

findings.issue: Reduced-motion spinner could remain invisible when rotation was removed
findings.change: Visible static loading indicator; unified sign-in flows rechecked

findings.issue: Small history/sheet controls and abrupt sheet dismissal
findings.change: 44px controls, clear focus, restrained exits and immediate interaction isolation

findings.issue: Tool overlays leaked keyboard focus and background interaction
findings.change: Contained focus, inert background, restored opener and separate scrolling body

findings.issue: Recent loader/return-to-top changes needed protection during suite-wide refinement
findings.change: Existing staged loader and capsule regressions retained and passed

validation.sharedModalBrowsers: Chromium and WebKit, including opening above another dialog

boundaries: Public production audit is read-only. Authenticated workflows use synthetic local accounts and fixtures. Existing owner-required page zoom restrictions are preserved.
